understanding: The inspected InmemStore is a test-only, process-local implementation of LogStore and StableStore. Its methods synchronize map access, but retain caller-owned log pointers and byte slices. Successful writes establish in-memory representations, not durable recovery evidence. Index accessors return maintained metadata rather than inspecting map contents. Other built-in storage and transport implementations remain deferred.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore write lock
implementation_guards: StoreLogs holds the instance write lock throughout the batch.
reads: Each supplied Log pointer and its Index
writes: lowIndex becomes l.Index whenever lowIndex is zero
highIndex increases when l.Index exceeds it
external_effects: Returns nil after a normally completed batch.
important_branches: StoreLog delegates to StoreLogs with one pointer.
An existing map key is overwritten.
An empty batch returns nil without changes.
No contiguity, ordering or nil-pointer validation is performed.
Stored Log objects are not copied.
existing_protections: Instance locking serializes map updates against other store methods.
unknowns: Caller ordering, ownership and mutation discipline are not established by these sources.
Protocol interpretation of successful storage completion has not been inspected.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore read lock
implementation_guards: Each method holds the instance read lock for its own operation.
reads: logs[index] and the referenced Log object
writes: GetLog shallow-copies the stored Log into the caller's destination when found.
external_effects: FirstIndex and LastIndex return the corresponding metadata field with nil error.
GetLog returns ErrLogNotFound for an absent key and nil after a successful copy.
important_branches: Index accessors do not compute extrema from the map.
A successful Log copy retains shared backing arrays for Data and Extensions.
async_boundaries: Separate accessor calls are not one atomic read transaction.
existing_protections: Read locking excludes concurrent store-method writes during each call.
unknowns: A returned log is not established to be immutable after the call.
Whether maintained bounds identify actual retained entries depends on preceding operations; consumers have not been inspected.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore write lock
behaviors.protocol_context: An initialized InmemStore instance with uint64 index metadata
implementation_guards: The instance write lock covers deletion and metadata updates.
writes: Deletes map keys using the loop j := min; j <= max; j++.
Sets lowIndex to max + 1 when min <= lowIndex.
Sets highIndex to min - 1 when max >= highIndex.
Resets both bounds to zero if the resulting lowIndex exceeds highIndex.
external_effects: Returns nil if the loop and subsequent updates complete.
important_branches: Missing map keys do not cause an error.
Metadata updates use interval endpoints without scanning surviving keys.
The method has no explicit endpoint-order or arithmetic-boundary checks.
existing_protections: Deletion and metadata changes are serialized against other instance methods.
unknowns: Reachable caller ranges, including arithmetic boundary values and ranges spanning gaps, have not been inspected.
No conclusion about protocol consequences of maintained bounds is established.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore write lock
behaviors.protocol_context: The byte-valued map of an initialized InmemStore
implementation_guards: The instance write lock covers assignment.
important_branches: Does not copy the value's backing array.
existing_protections: Map assignment is serialized against other instance methods.
unknowns: Caller mutation and ownership of value backing arrays are uninspected.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore read lock
behaviors.protocol_context: The byte-valued map of an initialized InmemStore
implementation_guards: The instance read lock covers lookup.
external_effects: Returns nil and an error with text "not found" when the retrieved slice is nil.
Otherwise returns the stored slice with nil error.
important_branches: An absent key and an explicitly stored nil slice take the same error branch.
A non-nil empty slice takes the success branch.
The returned slice is not copied.
existing_protections: Read locking excludes store-method writes during lookup.
unknowns: StableStore documents an empty byte slice for a missing key; the implementation returns nil with an error. Caller treatment and the applicable missing-key error expectation remain uninspected.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore write lock
behaviors.protocol_context: The uint64-valued map of an initialized InmemStore
implementation_guards: The instance write lock covers assignment.
important_branches: The uint64 map is distinct from the byte-valued map.
existing_protections: Scalar assignment is serialized against other instance methods.
unknowns: Protocol meanings of stored keys and consumers' persistence assumptions are uninspected.

behaviors.execution_owner: Calling goroutine holding the InmemStore read lock
behaviors.protocol_context: The uint64-valued map of an initialized InmemStore
implementation_guards: The instance read lock covers lookup.
external_effects: Returns the map value with nil error.
important_branches: Missing keys return zero with nil error, indistinguishable from an explicitly stored zero.
existing_protections: Read locking excludes store-method writes during lookup.
unknowns: Protocol consumers of the zero-or-absent representation have not been inspected.

facts.meaning: A normally completed StoreLogs call installed the last supplied pointer for each encountered index in this instance's log map.

identity.value: Last pointer assigned to that index by the call

facts.validity_context: At completion within the write-locked operation and until a subsequent overwrite or deletion. This asserts pointer installation, not immutable contents or accurate map extrema.
facts.recovery: NewInmemStore initializes empty maps and zero bounds; no reload mechanism is present in this implementation.
unknowns: Caller mutation can change referenced contents without another store call; those caller behaviors are not mapped.
No protocol consumer or restart guarantee is established.

facts.meaning: A completed Set call installed the supplied slice in the byte-valued map under the string-converted key.
facts.validity_context: Until a later Set for the same key. Installation does not establish immutable bytes or successful Get when the supplied slice is nil.
facts.durability: Volatile memory with shared slice backing storage.
facts.recovery: A new instance starts with an empty byte-valued map.
unknowns: Mutations through caller-held or returned slices are not represented by mapped caller behaviors.

facts.meaning: A completed SetUint64 call installed the supplied scalar under the string-converted key in the uint64 map.
facts.validity_context: Until a subsequent SetUint64 for the same key; byte-valued Set operations address a separate map.
facts.recovery: A new instance starts with an empty uint64 map; missing-key reads return zero.
unknowns: Actual protocol consumers and their interpretation of zero remain uninspected.

surfaces.reason: The complete implementation establishes construction with empty maps, method synchronization, volatile completion, aliasing, metadata updates and lookup branches. Its comments explicitly restrict intended use to tests. Mapping does not establish correctness or deployment activation.

surfaces.entry_point: Built-in storage and transport implementations: remaining adapters
surfaces.reason: Concrete snapshot stores, log-cache behavior and transport implementations remain uninspected. Recover their ownership, completion and failure semantics from exact source, then inspect selection sites to establish active variants. InmemStore inspection does not establish their semantics.

delta.rationale: Split the composite frontier into the sourced InmemStore implementation and an explicit deferred remainder. Facts describe only installed volatile representations. Preserve synchronization protections, shared-memory limitations and unresolved consumer semantics. The durable LogStore interface description and safety-oriented StableStore description are distinct from the test-only implementation's observed behavior; no normative obligation or defect conclusion is introduced.

limitations: No caller histories, deployment adapter selection, crash experiments or protocol consumers were inspected.
The attached oldestLog and metrics helpers do not establish protocol consumption of InmemStore metadata.
Activity and target-profile summaries remain unchanged because this task targets only the composite implementation surface.
